data.exact_reserve_text: The profit for the calendar year is split between a profit on the 2022 year of account of $8.4m and a profit on the 2021 and prior years of account of $5.0m. The implications of this analysis have been incorporated into our reserving approach for all years of account, which together with a loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates, has contributed to the back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis.
data.standardized_narrative: For the 2022 financial year, Syndicate 1971 experienced a gross reserve strengthening of $25.471 million, primarily impacting the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years. This adverse development is attributed to back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account, influenced by IBNR recalibration, assumptions from pricing current and prospective business, and a loading for inflation and actuarial best estimates. Despite this gross strengthening, the syndicate reported a net profit of $5.0 million on the 2021 and prior years of account from a P&L perspective.

data.data_quality_notes: The report presents conflicting information regarding prior year development. A net profit of $5.0m is reported for 2021 and prior years of account (P&L result), implying a release. However, the gross claims development triangle indicates a total strengthening of $25.471m for underwriting years 2019 and 2020. Narrative also mentions 'back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account'. The figure used for prior_year_development_gbp_m is derived from the gross claims development triangle, as per instructions to prioritize gross figures. A net deterioration of $10.434m is also mentioned in Note 6.
